visibleTestCases.title: Start Server and Exchange Flow-Controlled Packet
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, ListenPid, Port} = tcp_flow_worker:start_server(), {ok, S} = gen_tcp:connect("127.0.0.1", Port, [binary, {packet, raw}, {active, false}], 2000), ok = gen_tcp:send(S, <<"TEST_PING\r\n">>), {ok, Rep} = gen_tcp:recv(S, 0, 2000), gen_tcp:close(S), tcp_flow_worker:stop_server(ListenPid), Rep end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies server startup, client connection, and bounded echo reply.
